    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs=""
>
[Stone Soul Siblings](/Feats.aspx?ID=5264) <actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 79

**Prerequisites**
[Plant Soul Siblings](/Feats.aspx?ID=5257)

</column>

---

Your connection with nature's spirits has progressed to the point where you can even have casual conversation with pebbles and boulders. You gain [_stone tell_](/Spells.aspx?ID=310) as a primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. You get a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=2391) from stones.
